decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed office use, subject to appropriate conditions would not harm neighbours' living conditions and comply with the Councils policies E.1.4 (Change of Land Use to class B on Sites not in Employment Areas, Town Centres or Designated Sites), E.3.1 (Disabled Access), and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The hire vehicles associated with the business shall not be parked on, drop off or pick up customers from the site or the surrounding streets, Albion Road, Cromwell Road, Rossindel Road, Victoria Avenue, Nicholes Road, or Knevett Terrace.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall only be used for a car hire chauffer business and for no other purpose including any other purpose in Class B1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted for car hire ofice purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 8am to 7pm.
Condition : 6 - No more than three staff shall occupy the premises at any one time.
description: Change of use to private car hire offices.
